verdicts.tldr: past 25 changed realms the preview comment links pages the snapshot never rendered and tells the reviewer none were dropped
verdicts.details: plan.go:229-235 fills ChangedRealms from every directly changed realm, before any cap. plan.go:256-259 then truncates only `realms`, which becomes Plan.Realms and Plan.Dirs, so gnodev is never started with the surplus and the crawler writes no page for it. comment.go:60-64 iterates p.ChangedRealms and emits a link plus `source`/`help` links for each, and comment.go:86 prints the cap note as "the changed realms are always kept". pr-preview.yml:78 and :97 invoke gnopreview with no -max-realms, so the live cap is defaultMaxRealms = 25 (main.go:29) against 58 realm packages under examples/gno.land/r. Fix: filter ChangedRealms to the realms that survived the cap, or drop the always-kept sentence and mark the unrendered ones.
verdicts.evidence: cp tests/b7-claims-cap-bounds_test.go into misc/gnopreview and `go test -run TestB7CapDropsChangedRealms -v .` at ecf7af0f2 in a detached scratch worktree: `ChangedRealms=[gno.land/r/x/a gno.land/r/x/b gno.land/r/x/c] Realms=[gno.land/r/x/a] Dropped=2`, `changed realm gno.land/r/x/b   rendered=false linked in comment=true`, `comment asserts the changed realms are always kept while 2 of them were dropped`, --- FAIL. Scale, measured in the head worktree: `find examples/gno.land/r -name gnomod.toml | wc -l` = 58, and `git show --name-only 09a7530a6 -- examples/gno.land/r | grep .gno$ | xargs -n1 dirname | sort -u | wc -l` = 41. renderRelevant (plan.go:288) accepts gnomod.toml, so a tree-wide gno-version bump changes all 58. Merge base: `ls .worktrees/gno-review-6194-base/misc` has no gnopreview, so the whole path is new in this diff.
verdicts.verify_by: cp tests/b7-claims-cap-bounds_test.go misc/gnopreview/zz_b7_claims_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestB7CapDropsChangedRealms -v ./...

verdicts.tldr: the realm cap cuts Plan.Realms and Plan.Dirs but never ChangedRealms, so the sticky comment offers preview links for realms gnodev was never started with
verdicts.details: `realms = realms[:maxRealms]` at plan.go:258 is the only place the cap is applied, and it runs after ChangedRealms is already complete at plan.go:231. plan.Dirs (plan.go:271-272) is built from the truncated list, so gnodev serves only those packages and the crawler has no page for the rest. The stable sort at plan.go:253-255 orders changed realms first, which is what its comment at plan.go:251-252 means by "the cap never drops the realm the PR is actually about" -- that holds only while the changed realms number 25 or fewer. Fix: cap the changed realms too and count what it removed, so Comment() links only what was rendered.
verdicts.evidence: cp tests/b7-lines-changed-realms-dropped-by-cap.go into misc/gnopreview and `go test -run TestChangedRealmsSurviveTheCap -v .` at ecf7af0f2 in my own detached worktree: `changed=30 rendered=25 dropped=5` then `5 changed realm(s) are listed by Comment() but never rendered: [gno.land/r/x/raz gno.land/r/x/rba gno.land/r/x/rbb gno.land/r/x/rbc gno.land/r/x/rbd]`, --- FAIL: TestChangedRealmsSurviveTheCap. The production cap is the default: pr-preview.yml:78 runs `gnopreview plan -changed changed.txt` and :97-98 `gnopreview render -changed changed.txt` with no -max-realms flag, and changed.txt is `git diff --name-only "$base" "$HEAD_SHA"` (pr-preview.yml:64), the full path list. Merge base has no misc/gnopreview at all.
verdicts.verify_by: cp the repro into misc/gnopreview and run `go test ./... -run Cap -v`: BuildPlan with 30 changed realms and defaultMaxRealms=25 returns 30 ChangedRealms and 25 Realms, 5 of the changed realms absent from Realms/Dirs

verdicts.tldr: a seed realm that gets renamed leaves the gnoweb preview with no error and no note, and losing all four would crash the job instead of skipping it
verdicts.details: Empty() at plan.go:91 tests `!p.Gnoweb && len(p.Realms) == 0`, so a gnoweb plan is non-empty whatever Realms holds, and render() runs `urlOf(plan.Realms[0])` at main.go:112 right after that guard. The seeds are four hardcoded paths (plan.go:37-42) added only when `pkgs[r] != nil` (plan.go:265), with no error, no log and no Dropped increment when one does not resolve. All four resolve at this head, so the index is unreachable in CI today and the live half is the silent drop: one rename costs a sample page from every gnoweb preview, and nothing in the run or the comment says so. Fix: report an unresolvable seed, and make Empty() also cover len(Realms)==0 so the job prints "nothing to preview" rather than panicking.
verdicts.evidence: My own tests/judge-115-gnoweb-seed-drift_test.go, run at ecf7af0f2 in a detached scratch worktree, `go test -run TestJudge115 -v .`, all three PASS: TestJudge115SeedsStillResolve passes against the real ../../examples, so no current input reaches the index; TestJudge115RenamedSeedIsDroppedSilently logs `Realms=[gno.land/r/docs/security_patterns gno.land/r/gnoland/blog gno.land/r/gnoland/boards2/v0] Dropped=0`, the fourth seed gone with no error; TestJudge115AllSeedsGonePanics logs `Gnoweb=true Realms=[] Empty()=false` then `render() panics past Empty(): runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0`. The finder's tests/b7-reach-plan-caps.go reproduces the same panic (TestB7NonEmptyPlanWithNoRealms FAIL). plan_test.go:108-113 pins that state as expected (`wantRealms: []string{}`, `wantMode: "gnoweb"`). Merge base carries no misc/gnopreview.
